# Armsys UI 2.0.1 — complete reference for AI assistants

> Generated by scripts/build.mjs from AI_GUIDE.md, ai/*.json and ai/recipes/*.md. Use only what is listed here.

## Rules (AI_GUIDE.md)

Armsys UI is the default visual system for Armsys Technology web, admin, documentation and desktop (Electron) interfaces unless the user explicitly asks for another design system.

## Fast path

1. **One file:** read `llms-full.txt` — rules, tokens, every component with markup, the JS API and page recipes.
2. **Or structured:** `ai/index.json` → `ai/patterns.json` (pick the surface) → the matching `ai/recipes/*.md` → `ai/components.json` for exact class names → `ai/javascript.json` for behaviours → `ai/tokens.json` only if custom CSS is unavoidable.
3. Start from the closest page in `examples/` and keep its shell.

## Non-negotiable rules

- **Scope:** `<body class="aui">` for full pages, `<div class="aui">` for islands inside a host app. Nothing outside `.aui` is styled.
- **Classes:** only `aui-*` classes that exist in `ai/components.json`. Never invent class names; never add Bootstrap, Tailwind, MUI or another UI kit.
- **Tokens:** custom CSS (only for domain-specific layout) must use `--aui-*` tokens — no hard-coded colours, radii, shadows or spacing.
- **One frame for public pages:** website, docs, pricing, blog and data pages use the same `.aui-site-header` + `.aui-container` + `.aui-site-footer`. Do not change header height or container width per page.
- **Shells:** admin = `.aui-app`; docs = `.aui-site` + `.aui-docs`; auth = `.aui-auth` (split); Electron = `.aui-desktop` + `.aui-titlebar`; embedded = `.aui .aui--dense` + `.aui-mini`.
- **Behaviour via attributes:** use `data-aui-*` (modals, dropdowns, tabs, copy, toasts, confirm, OTP, tags, select, sort…). Write custom JS only for app logic, and call the `ArmsysUI` API (`confirm`, `prompt`, `toast`, `openModal`) instead of re-implementing UI.
- **Overlays are native `<dialog>`** (`aui-modal`, `aui-drawer`, `aui-sheet`, `aui-command`). They become bottom sheets on phones automatically.
- **Code blocks:** plain, escaped text in `<pre><code class="language-xxx">` inside `.aui-code`. Highlighting (highlight.js, Atom One Dark) is automatic — never hand-colour spans.
- **Icons:** `<svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-NAME"/></svg>` with names from `ai/icons.json`.

## Composition rules

- Buttons: exactly one `aui-btn--primary` per view; tone + style for quieter actions (`aui-btn aui-btn--soft aui-btn--danger`); icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
- Tones: `--accent --success --info --warning --danger --purple --pink --orange --yellow --teal --neutral` on badges, dots, alerts, callouts, avatars, icon boxes, progress, chips, buttons.
- Status: `aui-badge aui-badge--{tone}` + `aui-dot`; live states add `is-live`.
- Forms: `aui-field` → `aui-label[for]` → control → `aui-help`; errors with `is-invalid` + `aui-help is-error`; layout with `aui-form`, `aui-form-grid`, `aui-form-actions`.
- Destructive actions: `data-aui-confirm="…"` or `await ArmsysUI.confirm({ variant: 'danger' })`, followed by a toast.
- Tables: wrap in `aui-table-wrap` (inside `aui-card aui-card--clip` for app screens); numbers in `aui-num`; row actions in a `aui-dropdown` with `aui-menu--end`.
- Empty and loading states: `aui-empty`, `aui-skeleton`, `is-loading` on buttons.
- Spacing between blocks: `aui-stack`, `aui-row`, `aui-grid--N`, `aui-gap-*`, `aui-mt-*` (utilities load last and win).
- Accessibility: semantic elements, `aria-current="page"` for active nav, labels for every control, `aria-label` on icon buttons. Behaviours already handle focus, Escape and keyboard navigation.

## Surface selection

| Request | Start from | Recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin panel, dashboard, console, CRUD | `examples/dashboard.html`, `examples/data-table.html` | `ai/recipes/admin-panel.md` |
| Settings / profile | `examples/settings.html` | admin-panel.md §6 |
| Monitoring / logs | `examples/monitoring.html` | — |
| Login, register, reset, 2FA | `examples/login.html` … `two-factor.html` | `ai/recipes/auth.md` |
| Landing / corporate site | `examples/website.html` | `ai/recipes/marketing-site.md` |
| Docs / API reference | `examples/documentation.html` | `ai/recipes/docs-site.md` |
| Pricing | `examples/pricing.html` | marketing-site.md |
| Rankings / directories | `examples/leaderboard.html` | — |
| Electron / desktop | `examples/desktop.html` | `ai/recipes/electron-app.md` |
| Widget inside another app | `examples/embedded-panel.html` | — |

## Distribution

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@armsys-tech/ui@2.0.1/dist/armsys-ui.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@armsys-tech/ui@2.0.1/dist/armsys-ui.min.js" defer></script>
```

npm: `@armsys-tech/ui` — `import '@armsys-tech/ui/css'; import ArmsysUI from '@armsys-tech/ui';` (types included). Framework notes: `integrations/`.


## Design tokens

Scope `.aui`. Themes via `data-aui-theme="dark|light|system"`; accents via `data-aui-accent="violet|emerald|orange|rose|cyan|mono"`; density `aui--dense` / `aui--comfortable`.

## Components

Any component that lists 'tone' accepts a modifier ending in a tone name: --accent --success --info --warning --danger --purple --pink --orange --yellow --teal --neutral (also the generic classes aui-tone--accent, aui-tone--success …).

### Category: actions

#### button — `aui-btn`

- variant: aui-btn--primary, aui-btn--accent, aui-btn--secondary, aui-btn--outline, aui-btn--ghost, aui-btn--soft, aui-btn--link, aui-btn--social
- tone: aui-btn--success, aui-btn--danger, aui-btn--warning, aui-btn--info, aui-btn--purple, aui-btn--pink, aui-btn--orange, aui-btn--teal
- size: aui-btn--xs, aui-btn--sm, (md default), aui-btn--lg, aui-btn--xl
- shape: aui-btn--icon, aui-btn--pill, aui-btn--block, aui-btn--start
- state: is-loading, is-active, is-success, [aria-pressed="true"], :disabled, [aria-disabled="true"]
- elements: aui-btn-label, aui-btn-count, aui-btn-dot, aui-btn-end, aui-btn-brand
- data attributes: data-aui-confirm="Title" (+ data-aui-confirm-message, -text, -variant); data-aui-toast="Title"; data-aui-modal-open="#id"; data-aui-tooltip="Label"
- rule: Exactly one aui-btn--primary per view; secondary actions use the default variant or --outline/--ghost.
- rule: Tone + style: combine a tone with --soft/--outline/--ghost (aui-btn--soft aui-btn--danger). A tone alone is a solid button.
- rule: Icon-only buttons need aria-label.

```html
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary">Save</button>
<button class="aui-btn"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-plus"/></svg>New</button>
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--soft aui-btn--danger">Remove</button>
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--ghost aui-btn--icon aui-btn--sm" aria-label="Settings"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-settings"/></svg></button>
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary is-loading">Saving…</button>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

#### buttonGroup — `aui-btn-group`

- layout: aui-btn-group--vertical, aui-btn-group--block
- behaviour: [data-aui-toggle] single-select toggle group
- related: aui-btn-split, aui-btn-toolbar

```html
<div class="aui-btn-group" data-aui-toggle><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--icon is-active" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="List">…</button><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--icon" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Grid">…</button></div>
<div class="aui-btn-split"><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary">Deploy</button><div class="aui-dropdown" data-aui-dropdown><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary aui-btn--icon" data-aui-dropdown-trigger aria-label="More"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-chevron-down"/></svg></button><div class="aui-menu aui-menu--end">…</div></div></div>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

#### fab — `aui-fab`


```html
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary aui-btn--icon aui-fab" aria-label="Create"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-plus"/></svg></button>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

#### close — `aui-close`

- size: aui-close--sm
- rule: Renders its own × when empty; may contain an aui-icon.

```html
<button class="aui-close" data-aui-modal-close aria-label="Close"></button>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

#### link — `aui-link`

- variant: aui-link--quiet, aui-link--plain, aui-link-external
- related: aui-link-arrow

```html
<a class="aui-link" href="#">Docs</a>
<a class="aui-link-arrow" href="#">Read more <svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-arrow-right"/></svg></a>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

#### chip — `aui-chip`

- variant: aui-chip--soft
- tone: --accent|--success|--info|--warning|--danger|--purple|--pink|--orange|--yellow|--teal|--neutral
- size: aui-chip--sm, aui-chip--lg
- state: is-active, [aria-pressed="true"], :has(input:checked)
- elements: aui-chip-count, aui-chip-remove
- related: aui-chip-group

```html
<div class="aui-chip-group"><button class="aui-chip" aria-pressed="true">All <span class="aui-chip-count">128</span></button><button class="aui-chip" aria-pressed="false">Errors</button></div>
<span class="aui-chip aui-chip--soft aui-chip--accent">region: eu<button class="aui-chip-remove" data-aui-dismiss aria-label="Remove"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-x"/></svg></button></span>
```
Source: src/components/button.css

### Category: forms

#### field — `aui-field`

- layout: aui-field--inline, aui-field--horizontal
- elements: aui-label, aui-label-row, aui-required, aui-optional, aui-help, aui-help.is-error, aui-help.is-success, aui-help.is-warning, aui-counter
- rule: Always pair label[for] with the control id.
- rule: Errors: add is-invalid (or aria-invalid="true") on the control and aui-help is-error below it.

```html
<div class="aui-field"><label class="aui-label aui-required" for="name">Name</label><input class="aui-input" id="name"><p class="aui-help">Shown to teammates.</p></div>
<div class="aui-field"><div class="aui-label-row"><label class="aui-label" for="pw">Password</label><a class="aui-link" href="#">Forgot?</a></div><input class="aui-input" id="pw" type="password"></div>
```
Source: src/components/forms.css

#### input — `aui-input`

Also applies to: aui-select, aui-textarea
- size: aui-input--xs, aui-input--sm, (md default), aui-input--lg, aui-input--xl
- variant: aui-input--filled, aui-input--ghost, aui-input--pill, aui-input--mono, aui-textarea--code
- state: is-invalid, is-valid, is-warning, [aria-invalid="true"], :disabled, [readonly]
- data attributes: textarea[data-aui-autosize]; [data-aui-counter] (uses maxlength); input[data-aui-strength="#meter"]

```html
<input class="aui-input" placeholder="Search…">
<select class="aui-select"><option>eu-central</option></select>
<textarea class="aui-textarea" maxlength="280" data-aui-counter data-aui-autosize></textarea>
```
Source: src/components/forms.css

#### inputAffix — `aui-input-wrap`

- size: aui-input-wrap--xs, aui-input-wrap--sm, aui-input-wrap--lg, aui-input-wrap--xl
- elements: aui-icon (leading, first child), aui-input-start, aui-input-end, aui-input-action, aui-unit, aui-input-status.is-error|is-success, aui-reveal-on, aui-reveal-off
- data attributes: data-aui-clear; data-aui-password-toggle; data-aui-copy

```html
<div class="aui-input-wrap"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-search"/></svg><input class="aui-input" placeholder="Search"><div class="aui-input-end"><button class="aui-input-action" type="button" data-aui-clear aria-label="Clear"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-x-circle"/></svg></button></div></div>
<div class="aui-input-wrap"><input class="aui-input" type="password"><div class="aui-input-end"><button class="aui-input-action" type="button" data-aui-password-toggle aria-label="Show password"><svg class="aui-icon aui-reveal-off"><use href="#aui-i-eye"/></svg><svg class="aui-icon aui-reveal-on"><use href="#aui-i-eye-off"/></svg></button></div></div>
```
Source: src/components/forms.css

#### inputGroup — `aui-input-group`

- size: aui-input-group--sm, aui-input-group--lg
- elements: aui-input-addon, aui-input-addon--mono

```html
<div class="aui-input-group"><span class="aui-input-addon">https://</span><input class="aui-input"><button class="aui-btn">Save</button></div>
```
Source: src/components/forms.css

#### combobox — `select.aui-select[data-aui-select]`

Generated DOM: aui-combobox > aui-combobox-trigger + aui-menu[role=listbox]
- data attributes: data-aui-select; data-aui-search; data-placeholder; data-aui-search-placeholder; data-aui-empty; option[data-description]; multiple
- events: change/input on the native <select>
- JS: ArmsysUI.refreshSelect(select)
- rule: The native select stays in the DOM: forms, v-model and server posts keep working.
- rule: Opens as a bottom sheet on phones.

```html
<select class="aui-select" data-aui-select data-aui-search data-placeholder="Choose a country"><option value="" hidden></option><option value="tr">Türkiye</option><option value="de">Germany</option></select>
<select class="aui-select" multiple data-aui-select><optgroup label="Orders"><option selected>order.created</option></optgroup></select>
```
Source: src/components/forms.css + src/js/31-menus.js

#### checkbox — `aui-check`

- size: aui-check--sm, aui-check--lg

### Category: overlays

#### dropdown — `aui-dropdown[data-aui-dropdown]`

- menu: aui-menu--end, aui-menu--up, aui-menu--sm, aui-menu--lg, aui-menu--xl, aui-menu--scroll, aui-menu--context, is-static
- item: aui-menu-item--danger, role="menuitemcheckbox|menuitemradio" + aria-checked, data-aui-keep-open, :disabled
- elements: aui-menu, aui-menu-item, aui-menu-item-body, aui-menu-item-title, aui-menu-item-desc, aui-menu-item-end, aui-menu-label, aui-menu-sep, aui-menu-header, aui-menu-footer, aui-menu-search, aui-menu-empty, aui-menu-sub, aui-menu-grid
- data attributes: data-aui-dropdown; data-aui-dropdown-trigger; data-aui-placement="bottom-start|bottom-end|top-start|…"; data-aui-sheet="false|true"; data-aui-floating="false"; data-aui-context-menu="#menu"
- events: aui:dropdown-open (cancelable), aui:dropdown-opened, aui:dropdown-closed, aui:select {value,text} on items, aui:menu-check
- JS: ArmsysUI.openDropdown(el); ArmsysUI.closeDropdown(el); ArmsysUI.closeAll()
- rule: Menus are positioned with flip/shift (fixed) so they are never clipped by cards or tables.
- rule: Keyboard: ↑ ↓ Home End, typeahead, → opens a submenu, Esc closes.
- rule: On ≤640px they open as a bottom sheet with a drag handle.

```html
<div class="aui-dropdown" data-aui-dropdown><button class="aui-btn" data-aui-dropdown-trigger>Actions <svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-chevron-down"/></svg></button><div class="aui-menu"><button class="aui-menu-item"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-edit"/></svg>Rename<kbd class="aui-kbd">R</kbd></button><div class="aui-menu-sub"><button class="aui-menu-item">Share</button><div class="aui-menu"><button class="aui-menu-item">Copy link</button></div></div><div class="aui-menu-sep"></div><button class="aui-menu-item aui-menu-item--danger" data-aui-confirm="Delete?">Delete</button></div></div>
```
Source: src/components/menu.css + src/js/31-menus.js

#### modal — `dialog.aui-modal`

- size: aui-modal--sm, (520 default), aui-modal--lg, aui-modal--xl, aui-modal--full
- layout: aui-modal--center, aui-modal--no-sheet, aui-modal--blur, is-static (render inline)
- elements: aui-modal-header, aui-modal-heading, aui-modal-title, aui-modal-desc, aui-modal-body, aui-modal-body--flush, aui-modal-footer, aui-modal-footer--plain, aui-modal-footer--split, aui-modal-footer--stack, aui-modal-header--bordered, aui-modal-hero, aui-modal-handle (auto-inserted)
- data attributes: data-aui-modal-open="#id"; data-aui-modal-close; data-aui-static (no Esc/backdrop close); data-aui-value (close value); [autofocus]
- events: aui:open (cancelable), aui:opened, aui:close (cancelable), aui:closed {value}
- JS: ArmsysUI.openModal("#id"); ArmsysUI.closeModal("#id", value)
- rule: Use native <dialog>; never build modals from divs.
- rule: On ≤640px every modal is presented as a bottom sheet (drag handle, swipe down to close) unless aui-modal--no-sheet.
- rule: Animations, scroll-lock, focus return and backdrop click are handled by the JS.

```html
<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary" data-aui-modal-open="#invite">Invite</button>
<dialog class="aui-modal" id="invite" aria-labelledby="invite-title">
  <div class="aui-modal-header"><div class="aui-modal-heading"><h2 class="aui-modal-title" id="invite-title">Invite member</h2><p class="aui-modal-desc">They will get an email.</p></div><button class="aui-close" data-aui-modal-close aria-label="Close"></button></div>
  <div class="aui-modal-body">…</div>
  <div class="aui-modal-footer"><button class="aui-btn" data-aui-modal-close>Cancel</button><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary">Send</button></div>
</dialog>
```
Source: src/components/overlay.css + src/js/20-overlay.js

### Category: code

#### code — `aui-code`

- variant: aui-code--terminal, aui-code--scroll, aui-code--flush, aui-code--wrap, aui-code--sm, aui-code--lines
- elements: aui-code-header, aui-code-title, aui-code-lang, aui-code-actions, aui-code-tabs, aui-code-tab, aui-code-dots, aui-code-dots--color, aui-code-body, aui-code-footer, aui-copy, aui-copy--float, aui-copy--icon, aui-copy-idle, aui-copy-done, aui-line.is-hl|is-add|is-del|is-dim
- related: aui-cli, aui-code-inline, aui-code-prompt, aui-code-output, aui-tok-keyword|string|number|comment|function|property|type|operator (hand-written tokens)
- data attributes: pre > code.language-xxx (auto highlight.js, Atom One Dark); data-aui-lines; data-aui-hl="1,3-5"; data-aui-add="4"; data-aui-del="3"; data-aui-tabs + data-aui-tab/data-aui-panel (code groups); data-aui-tabs-sync="lang"; data-aui-copy; code[data-aui-no-highlight]
- JS: ArmsysUI.highlight(root); config.highlight / highlightUrl / highlightLanguageUrl
- rule: Write plain text inside <pre><code class="language-…">; escape < > &. Do not hand-colour spans.
- rule: Languages outside the highlight.js core bundle (e.g. dart, dockerfile, powershell, nginx) are fetched on demand.

```html
<div class="aui-code" data-aui-lines data-aui-hl="2"><div class="aui-code-header"><span class="aui-code-title"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-file"/></svg>client.ts</span><div class="aui-code-actions"><button class="aui-copy" data-aui-copy aria-label="Copy"><span class="aui-copy-idle"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-copy"/></svg>Copy</span><span class="aui-copy-done"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-check"/></svg>Copied</span></button></div></div><div class="aui-code-body"><pre><code class="language-typescript">const client = new Armsys();</code></pre></div></div>
<div class="aui-cli"><code>npm install @armsys-tech/ui</code><button class="aui-copy aui-copy--icon" data-aui-copy aria-label="Copy"><span class="aui-copy-idle"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-copy"/></svg></span><span class="aui-copy-done"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-check"/></svg></span></button></div>
```
Source: src/components/code.css + src/js/60-code.js

- JS: ArmsysUI.icons (names); ArmsysUI.addIcons({ name: "<path …/>" }); ArmsysUI.icon(name)
- rule: The JS injects the sprite; icons are 24×24 stroke icons. Brand icons (google, github, microsoft, apple, discord) are filled.

- layout: aui-site--fluid
- elements: aui-container, aui-container--content, aui-container--narrow, aui-container--fluid, aui-site-header, aui-site-header--transparent, aui-site-header--static, aui-site-header-inner, aui-site-brand, aui-site-nav, aui-site-nav-item, aui-site-nav-link, aui-site-search, aui-site-actions, aui-nav-toggle, aui-site-nav-mobile-actions, aui-mega, aui-mega--end, aui-mega-grid, aui-mega-group, aui-mega-title, aui-mega-item, aui-mega-item-title, aui-mega-item-desc, aui-mega-feature, aui-mega-footer, aui-search-trigger, aui-site-footer, aui-site-footer--compact, aui-footer-grid, aui-footer-brand, aui-footer-col, aui-footer-title, aui-footer-bottom, aui-footer-legal

```html
      <form class="aui-form">…fields…<button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary aui-btn--block" type="submit">Sign in</button></form>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-auth-bottom">…</div>
  </main>
</div>
</body>
```
Source: src/layouts/auth.css

#### desktop — `aui-desktop`

- platform: data-aui-platform="mac|win|linux"
- elements: aui-titlebar, aui-titlebar-title, aui-titlebar-center, aui-titlebar-actions, aui-window-controls, aui-window-control, aui-window-control--close, aui-desktop-body, aui-no-drag, aui-drag
- rule: Electron: BrowserWindow({ frame:false, titleBarStyle:"hidden" }); wire window-control buttons through your preload IPC.
- rule: macOS: data-aui-platform="mac" reserves space for the traffic lights and hides custom controls.


## JavaScript

Auto-initialises on DOMContentLoaded. A MutationObserver initialises markup inserted later (Vue/React/HTMX/Blazor/Electron), so frameworks only need to import it once. All behaviour is event delegation on document — no per-element setup, no cleanup.

### Config (`window.ArmsysUIConfig`)

- `autoInit`: true
- `observe`: true
- `sprite`: true — inject #aui-i-* SVG icon sprite
- `highlight`: true — lazy-load highlight.js for <pre><code class="language-*">
- `highlightUrl`: cdnjs highlight.js 11.11.1 core
- `highlightLanguageUrl`: cdnjs languages/{lang}.min.js
- `sheetBreakpoint`: 640 — menus/modals become bottom sheets at or below
- `toastPosition`: bottom-right
- `toastTimeout`: 4500
- `commandHotkey`: mod+k
- `storagePrefix`: aui-

### Data attributes

- `data-aui-modal-open="#id"` — Open a <dialog class="aui-modal|aui-drawer|aui-sheet">.
- `data-aui-modal-close` — Close the closest dialog (value from data-aui-value).
- `data-aui-static` — On a dialog: ignore Escape and backdrop clicks.
- `data-aui-dropdown / data-aui-dropdown-trigger` — Dropdown wrapper and its toggle button.
- `data-aui-placement` — On .aui-menu/.aui-popover: bottom-start|bottom-end|top-start|top-end|right-start|left-start…
- `data-aui-sheet="false|true"` — On [data-aui-dropdown]: control bottom-sheet presentation on phones.
- `data-aui-keep-open` — On a .aui-menu-item: keep the menu open after click.
- `data-aui-context-menu="#menu"` — Right-click area that opens a .aui-menu--context.
- `data-aui-popover="#id"` — Toggle a floating .aui-popover anchored to the trigger.
- `data-aui-tooltip="Text" [data-aui-tooltip-pos]` — CSS tooltip (top|bottom|left|right).
- `data-aui-tabs / data-aui-tab / data-aui-panel / data-aui-tabs-sync` — Tabs with keyboard support; sync groups share and remember selection.
- `data-aui-copy[="text|#target"]` — Copy text, a target element, or the nearest code block/input.
- `data-aui-toast="Title" (+ -message, -variant, -position)` — Show a toast on click.
- `data-aui-confirm="Title" (+ -message, -text, -variant)` — Ask for confirmation before the click proceeds (works on links, submit buttons, menu items).
- `data-aui-dismiss` — Remove the closest alert/notice/callout/toast/chip/[data-aui-dismissible].
- `data-aui-nav-toggle[="#target"]` — Toggle .is-open on the site header (default) or an off-canvas sidebar/docs nav (adds backdrop + scroll-lock).
- `data-aui-sidebar-collapse` — Toggle .aui-app--collapsed (icon rail). Remembered when the .aui-app has data-aui-collapsible.
- `data-aui-theme-toggle / data-aui-theme-set="light|dark|system"` — Theme switching, persisted in localStorage.
- `data-aui-choice + data-aui-choice-group / data-aui-when="group:value"` — Single-choice buttons that show/hide [data-aui-when] blocks (billing period, step views).
- `data-aui-toggle (on .aui-btn-group)` — Single-select toggle button group.
- `data-aui-select (on <select>)` — Enhanced searchable combobox (data-aui-search, data-placeholder, multiple, option[data-description]).
- `data-aui-otp="6" (+ -sep, -alpha, data-name)` — OTP inputs; fires aui:complete.
- `data-aui-tags (+ data-name, data-value, data-max)` — Tag input.
- `data-aui-stepper + data-aui-step="-1|1"` — Number stepper.
- `data-aui-clear / data-aui-password-toggle` — Input actions inside .aui-input-wrap.
- `data-aui-autosize / data-aui-counter / data-aui-strength="#meter"` — Textarea autosize, character counter, password strength meter.
- `data-aui-range-value` — Live value output next to input.aui-range.
- `data-aui-file-list="#list" (on .aui-dropzone)` — Render chosen files.
- `th[data-aui-sort] / data-aui-select-all / data-aui-select-row / table[data-aui-bulkbar]` — Client-side table sort and row selection with bulk bar.
- `data-aui-toc` — Scroll-spy for any nav of #anchor links.
- `data-aui-command / data-aui-command-open` — Command palette dialog and its triggers (+ mod+k).
- `data-aui-lines / data-aui-hl / data-aui-add / data-aui-del (on .aui-code)` — Line numbers, highlighted, added and removed lines.
- `data-aui-no-highlight (on code)` — Skip highlight.js for one block.

### API (`window.ArmsysUI` / `import ArmsysUI from "@armsys-tech/ui"`)

- `init(root?)` — Initialise behaviours inside root (idempotent).
- `openModal(ref, {returnFocus}) / closeModal(ref?, value)` — Open/close dialogs with animation, scroll-lock and focus return.
- `confirm(opts) → Promise<boolean>` — { title, message, confirmText, cancelText, variant, icon }
- `prompt(opts) → Promise<string|null>` — { title, label, value, placeholder, type, required, confirmText }
- `alert(opts) → Promise<void>` — { title, message, variant }
- `toast(opts) → element` — { title, message, variant, icon, action:{label,onClick}, position, timeout, loading } — returns el with .update(opts)
- `toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` — Loading toast that resolves to success/danger.
- `openDropdown(ref) / closeDropdown(ref) / closeAll()` — Programmatic menus.
- `openCommand(ref?)` — Open the command palette.
- `position(anchor|{x,y}, el, placement, offset)` — Flip/shift positioning helper for custom floating UI.
- `setTheme('light'|'dark'|'system') / getTheme()` — Theme control.
- `selectTab(tabEl, focus?)` — Select a tab.
- `copy(text)` — Clipboard write with fallback.
- `refreshSelect(select)` — Rebuild an enhanced select after changing options.
- `highlight(root?)` — Highlight new code blocks now.
- `addTag(el, value)` — Add a tag to a [data-aui-tags] input.
- `addIcons({name: svgInner}) / icon(name) / icons` — Icon sprite helpers.

### Events (bubble from the element)

`aui:open (cancelable)`, `aui:opened`, `aui:close (cancelable)`, `aui:closed {value}`, `aui:dropdown-open (cancelable)`, `aui:dropdown-opened`, `aui:dropdown-closed`, `aui:select {value,text}`, `aui:menu-check {checked,value}`, `aui:popover-opened`, `aui:popover-closed`, `aui:context`, `aui:complete {value}`, `aui:change {value}`, `aui:files {files}`, `aui:tab {tab}`, `aui:choice {group,value}`, `aui:copied {text}`, `aui:selection {count,rows}`, `aui:sort {column,direction}`, `aui:theme {theme,preference}`, `aui:sidebar {collapsed}`, `aui:nav-open`, `aui:nav-close`

## Page patterns

Public surfaces (website, docs, pricing, blog, data pages) share .aui-site + .aui-site-header + .aui-container + .aui-site-footer. Never give one page a different header or container width.

- **adminPanel** (application): admin panel, dashboard, console, back office, CRM, VPN/server management → examples/dashboard.html · shell: aui-app > aui-sidebar + aui-app-main > aui-topbar + aui-app-content · recipe: ai/recipes/admin-panel.md
- **monitoring** (application): live monitoring, operations, logs, status → examples/monitoring.html
- **dataManagement** (application): CRUD list, records, events table, bulk actions → examples/data-table.html
- **settings** (application): settings, profile, preferences, API keys → examples/settings.html
- **auth** (application): login, sign up, password reset, 2FA, email verification, invite → examples/login.html, examples/register.html, examples/forgot-password.html, examples/two-factor.html · shell: aui-auth > aui-auth-aside + aui-auth-main · recipe: ai/recipes/auth.md
- **website** (public): landing page, corporate site, product page → examples/website.html · shell: aui-site + aui-site-header + sections + aui-site-footer · recipe: ai/recipes/marketing-site.md
- **documentation** (public): docs, API reference, guides, changelog, knowledge base → examples/documentation.html · shell: aui-site + aui-site-header + aui-docs · recipe: ai/recipes/docs-site.md
- **pricing** (public): pricing, plans, comparison → examples/pricing.html
- **publicData** (public): leaderboard, ranking, directory, catalog → examples/leaderboard.html
- **embedded** (island): widget inside another app, WordPress/Laravel partial, browser extension popup → examples/embedded-panel.html · shell: <div class="aui aui--dense"> + aui-mini
- **desktopApp** (desktop): Electron, Tauri, WebView2, desktop tool → examples/desktop.html · shell: aui-desktop > aui-titlebar + aui-desktop-body > aui-app · recipe: ai/recipes/electron-app.md
- **componentReference** (public): design system docs, showcase → index.html

## Recipe — Admin panel / dashboard

Use for: admin panels, consoles, back offices, CRMs, server/VPN management, monitoring.
Reference implementation: `examples/dashboard.html`, `examples/data-table.html`, `examples/settings.html`.

## 5. Create / edit — modal (becomes a bottom sheet on phones)

```html
<dialog class="aui-modal" id="new-server" aria-labelledby="ns-title">
  <div class="aui-modal-header"><div class="aui-modal-heading"><h2 class="aui-modal-title" id="ns-title">Add server</h2><p class="aui-modal-desc">Connect a 3X-UI panel.</p></div><button class="aui-close" data-aui-modal-close aria-label="Close"></button></div>
  <div class="aui-modal-body">
    <form class="aui-form" id="ns-form">
      <div class="aui-form-grid">
        <div class="aui-field"><label class="aui-label aui-required" for="ns-name">Name</label><input class="aui-input" id="ns-name" required autofocus></div>
        <div class="aui-field"><label class="aui-label" for="ns-region">Region</label><select class="aui-select" id="ns-region" data-aui-select><option>Türkiye</option><option>Japan</option></select></div>
        <div class="aui-field aui-span-full"><label class="aui-label" for="ns-url">Panel URL</label><div class="aui-input-group"><span class="aui-input-addon">https://</span><input class="aui-input" id="ns-url"></div></div>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
  <div class="aui-modal-footer"><button class="aui-btn" data-aui-modal-close>Cancel</button><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary" type="submit" form="ns-form">Add server</button></div>
</dialog>
```

Detail views use `<dialog class="aui-drawer aui-drawer--lg">` with the same header/body/footer parts.

## 6. JavaScript glue (no framework needed)

```js
document.getElementById('ns-form').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn = document.querySelector('[form="ns-form"]');
  btn.classList.add('is-loading');
  try {
    await api.createServer(new FormData(e.target));
    ArmsysUI.closeModal('#new-server');
    ArmsysUI.toast({ title: 'Server added', variant: 'success' });
  } catch (err) {
    ArmsysUI.toast({ title: 'Could not add server', message: err.message, variant: 'danger' });
  } finally { btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); }
});
```

## Checklist

- One `aui-btn--primary` per view (the main create/save action).
- Destructive actions: `data-aui-confirm` or `await ArmsysUI.confirm({ variant: 'danger' })`, then a toast.
- Status = `aui-badge` + tone + `aui-dot`; numbers in tables use `aui-num`.
- Settings pages: `aui-settings` + `aui-form-section` + `aui-save-bar` (see `examples/settings.html`).
- Never add Bootstrap/Tailwind; custom CSS only for domain layout, using `--aui-*` tokens.


## Recipe — Authentication pages

Use for: sign in, sign up, forgot/reset password, 2FA/OTP, email verification, invitations, SSO.
Reference implementation: `examples/login.html`, `examples/register.html`, `examples/forgot-password.html`, `examples/two-factor.html`.

## Layout

`.aui-auth` is a split screen: **showcase on the left** (brand, headline, feature cards or checklist, testimonial, stats, status) and **the form on the right**. `aui-auth--reverse` swaps the sides, `aui-auth--center` gives a single centred card. The showcase is hidden at ≤900px (add `aui-auth-aside--mobile` to keep a compact header version).

```html
<body class="aui">
<div class="aui-auth">
  <aside class="aui-auth-aside">
    <div class="aui-auth-aside-top">
      <a class="aui-brand" href="/"><span class="aui-logo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-logo"/></svg></span>Armsys</a>
      <a class="aui-link-arrow aui-text-sm" href="/"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-arrow-left"/></svg>Back to website</a>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-auth-showcase">
      <h2 class="aui-auth-headline">The control plane for products that <em>never stop moving.</em></h2>
      <p class="aui-auth-subline">One sentence of value proposition.</p>
      <div class="aui-auth-features">
        <div class="aui-auth-feature"><span class="aui-icon-box aui-icon-box--sm aui-icon-box--accent"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-zap"/></svg></span><div class="aui-auth-feature-title">Fast</div><div class="aui-auth-feature-text">Short supporting line.</div></div>
        <!-- 2 or 4 cards -->
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="aui-auth-quote"><blockquote>“Testimonial.”</blockquote><figcaption><span class="aui-avatar aui-avatar--sm aui-avatar--pink">LR</span><span><b class="aui-text">Name</b> <span class="aui-text-subtle">· Role</span></span></figcaption></figure>
    <div class="aui-auth-aside-bottom aui-mt-6"><span>© 2026 Company</span><span class="aui-status aui-text-xs"><span class="aui-dot aui-dot--success is-live"></span>All systems operational</span></div>
  </aside>

  <main class="aui-auth-main">
    <div class="aui-auth-top">
      <a class="aui-brand aui-show-mobile" href="/"><span class="aui-logo aui-logo--sm"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-logo"/></svg></span>Armsys</a>
      <span class="aui-row aui-gap-3 aui-ml-auto"><span>New here?</span><a class="aui-btn aui-btn--outline aui-btn--sm" href="/register">Create account</a></span>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-auth-form">
      <div class="aui-auth-header"><h1 class="aui-auth-title">Welcome back</h1><p class="aui-auth-desc">Sign in to continue.</p></div>
      <div class="aui-auth-social aui-auth-social--2">
        <button class="aui-btn aui-btn--social aui-btn--lg" type="button"><svg class="aui-btn-brand" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-google"/></svg>Google</button>
        <button class="aui-btn aui-btn--social aui-btn--lg" type="button"><svg class="aui-btn-brand" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-github"/></svg>GitHub</button>
      </div>
      <div class="aui-divider-text aui-auth-divider">or continue with email</div>
      <form class="aui-form" method="post">
        <div class="aui-field"><label class="aui-label" for="email">Email</label><div class="aui-input-wrap"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-mail"/></svg><input class="aui-input" id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></div></div>
        <div class="aui-field">
          <div class="aui-label-row"><label class="aui-label" for="password">Password</label><a class="aui-link" href="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</a></div>
          <div class="aui-input-wrap"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-lock"/></svg><input class="aui-input" id="password" name="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required><div class="aui-input-end"><button class="aui-input-action" type="button" data-aui-password-toggle aria-label="Show password"><svg class="aui-icon aui-reveal-off"><use href="#aui-i-eye"/></svg><svg class="aui-icon aui-reveal-on"><use href="#aui-i-eye-off"/></svg></button></div></div>
        </div>
        <label class="aui-check"><input type="checkbox" name="remember"><span>Keep me signed in</span></label>
        <button class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary aui-btn--block" type="submit">Sign in</button>
      </form>
      <p class="aui-auth-legal">By continuing you agree to the <a href="/terms">Terms</a>.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-auth-bottom"><div class="aui-footer-legal"><a href="/privacy">Privacy</a><a href="/terms">Terms</a></div></div>
  </main>
</div>
</body>
```

## Variants of the form column

- **Register** — optional `aui-wizard` on top, `aui-form-grid` for first/last name, password with `data-aui-strength="#meter"` and `<div class="aui-strength" id="meter" data-level="0"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>`, terms checkbox.
- **Forgot password** — `<a class="aui-auth-back">` + `aui-icon-box aui-icon-box--lg aui-icon-box--accent` in `aui-auth-header`; success state uses `.aui-auth-result` (toggle with `data-aui-choice` / `data-aui-when` or your framework).
- **2FA** — `<div class="aui-otp" data-aui-otp="6" data-aui-otp-sep="3" data-name="code"></div>`; listen for `aui:complete` to auto-submit; mark `is-invalid` + `is-shake` on failure.
- **Server errors** — `aui-alert aui-alert--danger aui-alert--sm` above the form, `is-invalid` on fields, `aui-help is-error` messages.

Inside `.aui-auth-form` inputs and block buttons are 42px tall automatically.


## Recipe — Documentation / API reference site

Use for: product docs, API reference, guides, changelogs, knowledge bases.
Reference implementation: `examples/documentation.html` and the component reference `index.html`.

**Rule:** documentation uses the *same* `.aui-site-header` and container as the marketing site. Never give docs a different header, height or width — that is what makes moving between site and docs feel seamless.

```html
<body class="aui aui-site">
  <header class="aui-site-header">
    <div class="aui-container aui-site-header-inner">
      <a class="aui-site-brand" href="/"><span class="aui-logo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-logo"/></svg></span>Armsys</a>
      <nav class="aui-site-nav"><a class="aui-site-nav-link" href="/">Product</a><a class="aui-site-nav-link" aria-current="page" href="/docs">Docs</a><a class="aui-site-nav-link" href="/pricing">Pricing</a></nav>
      <div class="aui-site-search"><button class="aui-search-trigger" data-aui-command-open><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-search"/></svg><span>Search docs…</span><kbd class="aui-kbd">⌘K</kbd></button></div>
      <div class="aui-site-actions"><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--ghost aui-btn--icon aui-btn--sm" data-aui-theme-toggle aria-label="Theme"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-sun"/></svg></button><a class="aui-btn aui-btn--primary aui-btn--sm" href="/signup">Get started</a><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--ghost aui-btn--icon aui-btn--sm aui-nav-toggle" data-aui-nav-toggle aria-label="Menu"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-menu"/></svg></button></div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="aui-docs">
    <aside class="aui-docs-sidebar" id="docs-nav">
      <nav class="aui-docs-nav">
        <div class="aui-docs-group">
          <div class="aui-docs-group-title"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-book"/></svg>Getting started</div>

        </details>
      </nav>
    </aside>

    <main class="aui-docs-main">
      <article class="aui-docs-article">
        <header class="aui-docs-header">
          <nav class="aui-breadcrumb"><ol><li><a href="/docs">Docs</a></li><li><span aria-current="page">Publish events</span></li></ol></nav>
          <h1 class="aui-docs-title">Publish events</h1>
          <p class="aui-docs-lead">One-paragraph summary.</p>

            <div class="aui-code-header"><div class="aui-code-tabs"><button class="aui-code-tab" data-aui-tab="ts">TypeScript</button><button class="aui-code-tab" data-aui-tab="cs">C#</button></div><div class="aui-code-actions"><button class="aui-copy" data-aui-copy aria-label="Copy"><span class="aui-copy-idle"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-copy"/></svg>Copy</span><span class="aui-copy-done"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-check"/></svg>Copied</span></button></div></div>

  </div>
  <footer class="aui-site-footer aui-site-footer--compact"><div class="aui-container"><div class="aui-footer-bottom"><span>© 2026 Armsys Technology</span><div class="aui-footer-legal"><a href="#">Privacy</a><a href="#">Terms</a></div></div></div></footer>
</body>
```

## API reference blocks

Two-column endpoint: `<section class="aui-api"><div>description + aui-params</div><div class="aui-api-examples">aui-code groups + response</div></section>`. Endpoint bar: `aui-endpoint` with `aui-method--get|post|put|patch|delete|ws`. Parameters: `aui-params > aui-param > aui-param-head (aui-param-name, aui-param-type, aui-param-req) + aui-param-desc`. Responses: `aui-responses > aui-response > aui-status-code.is-2xx`.

## Code

Write plain code in `<pre><code class="language-xxx">` (escape `<`, `>`, `&`). Armsys UI highlights it with highlight.js + Atom One Dark. Line tools on the `.aui-code` wrapper: `data-aui-lines`, `data-aui-hl="2,4-6"`, `data-aui-add`, `data-aui-del`.


## Recipe — Electron / desktop application

Use for: Electron, Tauri and WebView2 apps that should look like the Armsys web console.
Reference implementation: `examples/desktop.html`. Integration notes: `integrations/electron.md`.

```html
<body class="aui aui-desktop" data-aui-platform="win"><!-- set from preload: mac | win | linux -->
  <header class="aui-titlebar">
    <div class="aui-titlebar-title"><span class="aui-logo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="#aui-i-logo"/></svg></span>App name</div>
    <div class="aui-titlebar-center aui-hide-mobile"><button class="aui-search-trigger" data-aui-command-open><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-search"/></svg><span>Search…</span><kbd class="aui-kbd aui-kbd--sm">Ctrl K</kbd></button></div>
    <div class="aui-titlebar-actions"><button class="aui-btn aui-btn--ghost aui-btn--icon" data-aui-theme-toggle aria-label="Theme"><svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-moon"/></svg></button></div>
    <div class="aui-window-controls">
      <button class="aui-window-control" id="win-min" aria-label="Minimize"><svg viewBox="0 0 10 10"><path d="M0 5h10"/></svg></button>
      <button class="aui-window-control" id="win-max" aria-label="Maximize"><svg viewBox="0 0 10 10"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="9" height="9"/></svg></button>
      <button class="aui-window-control aui-window-control--close" id="win-close" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 10 10"><path d="m0 0 10 10M10 0 0 10"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="aui-desktop-body">
    <div class="aui-app aui-app--collapsed">
      <aside class="aui-sidebar aui-sidebar--alt">…icon rail: aui-nav-item with data-aui-tooltip + data-aui-tooltip-pos="right"…</aside>
      <div class="aui-app-main">
        <div class="aui-tool" style="height:100%">
          <div class="aui-tool-bar">…</div>
          <div class="aui-tool-body"><div class="aui-pane">…list…</div><div class="aui-pane aui-grow">…detail…</div></div>
          <div class="aui-statusbar">…</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <dialog class="aui-command" data-aui-command>…</dialog>
</body>
```

- The title bar is a drag region; interactive children are automatically `no-drag`. Use `.aui-no-drag` / `.aui-drag` for custom areas.
- Scrolling happens inside `.aui-app-main` / panes, never the window.
- `aui-desktop` makes text non-selectable except inputs, code, prose and table cells (add `.aui-selectable` elsewhere).
- Offline apps: copy `highlight.min.js` locally and set `window.ArmsysUIConfig = { highlightUrl: './vendor/highlight.min.js', highlightLanguageUrl: './vendor/languages/{lang}.min.js' }` (or `highlight: false`). Allow it in your CSP.


## Recipe — Corporate / product website

Use for: landing pages, corporate sites, product pages, pricing teasers.
Reference implementation: `examples/website.html`, `examples/pricing.html`.

## Building blocks

- Header mega menu: `<div class="aui-site-nav-item"><button class="aui-site-nav-link">Products <svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-chevron-down"/></svg></button><div class="aui-mega" style="--cols:2"><div class="aui-mega-grid"><div class="aui-mega-group"><div class="aui-mega-title">Platform</div><a class="aui-mega-item" href="#"><span class="aui-icon-box">…</span><span><span class="aui-mega-item-title">Stream</span><span class="aui-mega-item-desc">…</span></span></a></div></div></div></div>`
- Cards: `aui-card-grid` + `aui-product-card` / `aui-feature-card` / `aui-resource-card`; tiles: `aui-tile-grid` + `aui-tile`.
- Social proof: `aui-logo-strip`, `aui-quote`, `aui-stats aui-stats--public`.
- FAQ: `aui-faq` (or `aui-accordion--flush`) inside `aui-faq-layout`.
- Pricing: `aui-pricing-grid--3` + `aui-pricing-card` (+ `is-featured`), toggle monthly/yearly with `data-aui-choice` + `data-aui-when`.
- Transparent header over a hero: `aui-site-header--transparent` (turns solid after scrolling).
- Full-bleed site: `<body class="aui aui-site aui-site--fluid">` changes the frame for every page at once.
